title: Herbalife to Participate in 1 on 1 Meetings at Stephens Annual Investment Conference on November 19

# Herbalife to Participate in 1 on 1 Meetings at Stephens Annual Investment Conference on November 19


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_116d67fec056f15e23e82e82fb2384de/herbalife/news/2026-11-06_Herbalife_to_Participate_in_1_on_1_Meetings_at_961.pdf) Nov 6, 2026 • 7:05 am ET


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Herbalife Ltd. (NYSE: HLF), a premier health and wellness company, community and platform, today announced Scott Schaefer, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in one on one meetings at the Stephens Annual Investment Conference in Nashville on Thursday, November 19, 2026.


For more information about the Stephens Annual Investment Conference:[https://www.stephens.com/events/save-the-date-stephens-annual-investment-conference](https://www.stephens.com/events/save-the-date-stephens-annual-investment-conference)


**About Herbalife Ltd.**


Herbalife (NYSE: HLF) is a premier health and wellness company, community and platform that has been changing people's lives with great nutrition products and a business opportunity for its independent distributors since 1980. The Company offers science-backed products to consumers in more than 90 markets through entrepreneurial distributors who provide one-on-one coaching and a supportive community that inspires their customers to embrace a healthier, more active lifestyle to live their best life.


For more information, visit[https://ir.herbalife.com](https://ir.herbalife.com/) .
